clips.title: The story
paras: Azuregos is an eccentric blue dragon stationed along the coast of Azshara to protect ancient Highborne relics. Entrusted with safeguarding immense magical power by the Spell-Weaver Malygos, he prefers quiet study over violence, but he will readily swat aside any adventurer foolish enough to disturb his vigil.

Drawn to the magic-soaked shores of Azshara, Azuregos chose the ancient ruins of Eldarath as his sanctuary. Countless relics survived the Great Sundering along these shattered coasts, and Azuregos considers it his sacred duty as a servant of Malygos to keep such powerful artifacts away from careless mortals. Rather than lurking in a dark cave, he freely roams the crags and beaches, proudly dubbing himself the lord of all magic in the region. Though blessed with a sardonic sense of humor, he fiercely defends Azshara's treasures against the endless stream of adventurers seeking fame or plunder.
